_note: The plushie machine (F1/F2, Plushie, the workbench's third page). Every number is a placeholder from the mockup (design/mockups/screens/sacrifice-reels.html look A). You pick a keeper and feed pets into the hopper; the best one in the hopper hops in. spins: how many spins a fed pet gives, by its rarity. nudges: how many nudges its finish adds to the pool. One reel per part: each spin lands on a button, a blank or a crack. button / crack: the chance in % of landing a button / a crack, by how many buttons that part has already (0, 1, 2, 3, 4; a part with max_buttons is full and doesn't spin); blank is the rest. crack_min: a crack never gets rarer than this (lucky pets). puff: wisps a miss puffs out, by the fed pet's rarity; crack_puff: a crack puffs this many times as much; perfection: every button the keeper has makes misses puff this much more (x 1 + perfection x buttons). knack_per_button: each button on a part makes that part's knack this much bigger (x 1 + knack_per_button x buttons). holds: reels you can hold at once, before buying more. hopper_max: pets waiting in the hopper at most. shop: what wisps buy (nudge and hold: the first costs wisps, each next one grow times as much; wild: the wild 6th reel for one fed pet costs wisps x (the fed pet's rarity step + 1); max: no price goes past this). STAKES (playtest 1): misses puff nothing (puff 0: wisps come from the well and its rooms). needs: the rarity a fed pet must be (at least) to spin a part's reel, by how many buttons that part has (0, 1, 2, 3, 4): a weaker pet leaves that reel still. crack_pops: buttons a crack knocks off that part (sewn ones!), hold_pops: more when the reel was on hold. traits: how a fed pet's traits tilt its reels (button / crack: + that many % points, spins: + that many spins, wisps: misses puff that many times as much).
